notes: All five C++ submissions are RTE, so there is no accepted reference. DMOJ serves no statement; tests.toml and gen.py come from the official statement on Luogu P9483 and LOJ 3984, whose four sample files are the inline cases. orig.cpp is a corpus-written search over merge layers: a DP over the multiset of per-book move counts by pile count, keeping each multiset's least wear and pruning with a lower bound against a greedy schedule. It matches the four official samples, an exponential brute over every merge order on 600 random cases (n <= 8), and the same DP pruned only by wear on 320 random cases (9 <= n <= 100).
